messages.subject: Re: Error running MaAsLin on Galaxy
messages.body_plain:
I've gotten this same error using the galaxy maaslin module. I believe it occurs whenever there is any kind of problem in the metadata rows. I have encountered it by having data presented alphabetically when it expected numeric (M/F instead of 1/0 for Sex) and when I tried submitting data where I had data from the same site at two different time points. It seems like not all metadata rows will accept the same entry across multiple samples, the exceptions being sex, age, cohort, etc. Or possibly I have been trying to call the metadata row by an unaccepted name. I'm still working that one out, and would love to hear if anyone ha solved this issue.
David

messages.subject: Compare to metabolomics instead of microbial abundance
messages.subject_clean: Compare to metabolomics instead of microbial abundance
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I was looking into using Maaslin on a targeted metabolomics dataset with multiple clinical variables. By looking at the requirements of Maaslin it looks like my data needs to be proportional to be able to use it. Just wanted to make sure I understood it correctly and that I would have to transform my data to make it proportional for each sample before trying to run it.

Kind regards,

Brigida Rusconi

Brigida Rusconi, PhD
Postdoctoral Fellow
Department of Pediatrics
Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis
